RadioID API / Data Use Policy excerpt (fetched for licence review only; NO repeater data committed).
Source: https://radioid.net/api/ (retrieved with fixture fetch script)
---
Important use rules This API, the static dump files, and any screen-scraped reuse of RadioID data are covered by the same policy. Do not mirror or re-publish RadioID as a public feed, bulk export, reusable database, competing directory, or commercial data service without written permission. Commercial, bulk, and public-facing integration uses may require approval. Automated clients should send a clear User-Agent with an app name and contact address. See the full API and Data Use Policy or download the text version . Pagination in plain English Start with page=1 . If the response says "pages": 4 , request the same URL again with page=2 , then page=3 , until you reach page 4. Keep your filters the same. Only change the page number. The response includes page , pages , count , and results so you can see where you are. Endpoints /api/users /api/users/cplus /api/users/nxdn /api/repeaters/dmr
